targets.rawSql: select now() as time, count(*) as value from codex_tool_results_dashboard where $__timeFilter(event_time) and ($v$${team:text}$v$ = $v$All$v$ or team = $v$${team:text}$v$) and ($v$${user_id:text}$v$ = $v$All$v$ or user_id = $v$${user_id:text}$v$) and ($v$${conversation_id:text}$v$ = $v$All$v$ or conversation_id = $v$${conversation_id:text}$v$) and ($v$${repository:text}$v$ = $v$All$v$ or repository = $v$${repository:text}$v$) and ($v$${model:text}$v$ = $v$All$v$ or model = $v$${model:text}$v$) and ($v$${tool:text}$v$ = $v$All$v$ or tool_name = $v$${tool:text}$v$);

select now() as time, count(distinct conversation_id) as value from codex_tool_results_dashboard where $__timeFilter(event_time) and conversation_id is not null and ($v$${team:text}$v$ = $v$All$v$ or team = $v$${team:text}$v$) and ($v$${user_id:text}$v$ = $v$All$v$ or user_id = $v$${user_id:text}$v$) and ($v$${conversation_id:text}$v$ = $v$All$v$ or conversation_id = $v$${conversation_id:text}$v$) and ($v$${repository:text}$v$ = $v$All$v$ or repository = $v$${repository:text}$v$) and ($v$${model:text}$v$ = $v$All$v$ or model = $v$${model:text}$v$) and ($v$${tool:text}$v$ = $v$All$v$ or tool_name = $v$${tool:text}$v$);

select now() as time, coalesce(round(100.0 * avg(case when tool_success = true then 1.0 when tool_success = false then 0.0 else null end), 2), 0) as value from codex_tool_results_dashboard where $__timeFilter(event_time) and ($v$${team:text}$v$ = $v$All$v$ or team = $v$${team:text}$v$) and ($v$${user_id:text}$v$ = $v$All$v$ or user_id = $v$${user_id:text}$v$) and ($v$${conversation_id:text}$v$ = $v$All$v$ or conversation_id = $v$${conversation_id:text}$v$) and ($v$${repository:text}$v$ = $v$All$v$ or repository = $v$${repository:text}$v$) and ($v$${model:text}$v$ = $v$All$v$ or model = $v$${model:text}$v$) and ($v$${tool:text}$v$ = $v$All$v$ or tool_name = $v$${tool:text}$v$);

select now() as time, coalesce(round((percentile_cont(0.95) within group (order by tool_duration_ms))::numeric, 2), 0) as value from codex_tool_results_dashboard where $__timeFilter(event_time) and tool_duration_ms is not null and ($v$${team:text}$v$ = $v$All$v$ or team = $v$${team:text}$v$) and ($v$${user_id:text}$v$ = $v$All$v$ or user_id = $v$${user_id:text}$v$) and ($v$${conversation_id:text}$v$ = $v$All$v$ or conversation_id = $v$${conversation_id:text}$v$) and ($v$${repository:text}$v$ = $v$All$v$ or repository = $v$${repository:text}$v$) and ($v$${model:text}$v$ = $v$All$v$ or model = $v$${model:text}$v$) and ($v$${tool:text}$v$ = $v$All$v$ or tool_name = $v$${tool:text}$v$);

with filtered as (select * from codex_tool_events_dashboard where $__timeFilter(event_time) and ($v$${team:text}$v$ = $v$All$v$ or team = $v$${team:text}$v$) and ($v$${user_id:text}$v$ = $v$All$v$ or user_id = $v$${user_id:text}$v$) and ($v$${conversation_id:text}$v$ = $v$All$v$ or conversation_id = $v$${conversation_id:text}$v$) and ($v$${repository:text}$v$ = $v$All$v$ or repository = $v$${repository:text}$v$) and ($v$${model:text}$v$ = $v$All$v$ or model = $v$${model:text}$v$) and ($v$${tool:text}$v$ = $v$All$v$ or tool_name = $v$${tool:text}$v$)) select tool_name, sum(case when event_name = 'codex.tool_decision' then 1 else 0 end) as decision_events, sum(case when event_name = 'codex.tool_result' then 1 else 0 end) as result_events, sum(case when event_name = 'codex.tool_result' and tool_success = true then 1 else 0 end) as success_calls, sum(case when event_name = 'codex.tool_result' and tool_success = false then 1 else 0 end) as failed_calls, sum(case when event_name = 'codex.tool_result' and tool_success is null then 1 else 0 end) as unknown_calls, round(100.0 * avg(case when event_name = 'codex.tool_result' and tool_success = true then 1.0 when event_name = 'codex.tool_result' and tool_success = false then 0.0 else null end), 2) as success_rate_pct, round(avg(case when event_name = 'codex.tool_result' then tool_duration_ms else null end), 2) as avg_duration_ms, round((percentile_cont(0.50) within group (order by tool_duration_ms) filter (where event_name = 'codex.tool_result' and tool_duration_ms is not null))::numeric, 2) as p50_duration_ms, round((percentile_cont(0.95) within group (order by tool_duration_ms) filter (where event_name = 'codex.tool_result' and tool_duration_ms is not null))::numeric, 2) as p95_duration_ms, round((avg(tool_output_size) filter (where event_name = 'codex.tool_result' and tool_output_size is not null))::numeric, 2) as avg_output_size from filtered group by tool_name order by result_events desc, decision_events desc, tool_name;

select $__timeGroupAlias(event_time, '5m'), tool_name as metric, round(avg(tool_duration_ms), 2) as value from codex_tool_results_dashboard where $__timeFilter(event_time) and tool_duration_ms is not null and ($v$${team:text}$v$ = $v$All$v$ or team = $v$${team:text}$v$) and ($v$${user_id:text}$v$ = $v$All$v$ or user_id = $v$${user_id:text}$v$) and ($v$${conversation_id:text}$v$ = $v$All$v$ or conversation_id = $v$${conversation_id:text}$v$) and ($v$${repository:text}$v$ = $v$All$v$ or repository = $v$${repository:text}$v$) and ($v$${model:text}$v$ = $v$All$v$ or model = $v$${model:text}$v$) and ($v$${tool:text}$v$ = $v$All$v$ or tool_name = $v$${tool:text}$v$) group by 1, 2 order by 1;

select conversation_id, count(*) as total_calls, count(distinct tool_name) as distinct_tools, round(avg(tool_duration_ms), 2) as avg_duration_ms, round((percentile_cont(0.95) within group (order by tool_duration_ms))::numeric, 2) as p95_duration_ms, max(event_time) as last_event_time from codex_tool_results_dashboard where $__timeFilter(event_time) and conversation_id is not null and ($v$${team:text}$v$ = $v$All$v$ or team = $v$${team:text}$v$) and ($v$${user_id:text}$v$ = $v$All$v$ or user_id = $v$${user_id:text}$v$) and ($v$${conversation_id:text}$v$ = $v$All$v$ or conversation_id = $v$${conversation_id:text}$v$) and ($v$${repository:text}$v$ = $v$All$v$ or repository = $v$${repository:text}$v$) and ($v$${model:text}$v$ = $v$All$v$ or model = $v$${model:text}$v$) and ($v$${tool:text}$v$ = $v$All$v$ or tool_name = $v$${tool:text}$v$) group by conversation_id order by last_event_time desc limit 50;

select event_time, user_id, conversation_id, tool_name, tool_call_id, model, tool_duration_ms, tool_success, tool_output_size from codex_tool_results_dashboard where $__timeFilter(event_time) and ($v$${team:text}$v$ = $v$All$v$ or team = $v$${team:text}$v$) and ($v$${user_id:text}$v$ = $v$All$v$ or user_id = $v$${user_id:text}$v$) and ($v$${conversation_id:text}$v$ = $v$All$v$ or conversation_id = $v$${conversation_id:text}$v$) and ($v$${repository:text}$v$ = $v$All$v$ or repository = $v$${repository:text}$v$) and ($v$${model:text}$v$ = $v$All$v$ or model = $v$${model:text}$v$) and ($v$${tool:text}$v$ = $v$All$v$ or tool_name = $v$${tool:text}$v$) order by event_time desc limit 100;

select event_time, user_id, conversation_id, tool_name, tool_call_id, model, tool_duration_ms, tool_error_code, tool_error_message, repository from codex_tool_results_dashboard where $__timeFilter(event_time) and ($v$${team:text}$v$ = $v$All$v$ or team = $v$${team:text}$v$) and ($v$${user_id:text}$v$ = $v$All$v$ or user_id = $v$${user_id:text}$v$) and ($v$${conversation_id:text}$v$ = $v$All$v$ or conversation_id = $v$${conversation_id:text}$v$) and ($v$${repository:text}$v$ = $v$All$v$ or repository = $v$${repository:text}$v$) and ($v$${model:text}$v$ = $v$All$v$ or model = $v$${model:text}$v$) and ($v$${tool:text}$v$ = $v$All$v$ or tool_name = $v$${tool:text}$v$) and tool_success = false order by event_time desc limit 50;

select event_time, user_id, conversation_id, tool_name, tool_call_id, model, tool_duration_ms, tool_success, tool_output_size from codex_tool_results_dashboard where $__timeFilter(event_time) and ($v$${team:text}$v$ = $v$All$v$ or team = $v$${team:text}$v$) and ($v$${user_id:text}$v$ = $v$All$v$ or user_id = $v$${user_id:text}$v$) and ($v$${conversation_id:text}$v$ = $v$All$v$ or conversation_id = $v$${conversation_id:text}$v$) and ($v$${repository:text}$v$ = $v$All$v$ or repository = $v$${repository:text}$v$) and ($v$${model:text}$v$ = $v$All$v$ or model = $v$${model:text}$v$) and ($v$${tool:text}$v$ = $v$All$v$ or tool_name = $v$${tool:text}$v$) and tool_duration_ms is not null order by tool_duration_ms desc, event_time desc limit 50;

select now() as time, count(*) as value from codex_fn_call_events_dashboard where $__timeFilter(event_time) and ($v$${team:text}$v$ = $v$All$v$ or team = $v$${team:text}$v$) and ($v$${user_id:text}$v$ = $v$All$v$ or user_id = $v$${user_id:text}$v$) and ($v$${conversation_id:text}$v$ = $v$All$v$ or conversation_id = $v$${conversation_id:text}$v$) and ($v$${repository:text}$v$ = $v$All$v$ or repository = $v$${repository:text}$v$) and ($v$${model:text}$v$ = $v$All$v$ or model = $v$${model:text}$v$) and is_done = false;

select now() as time, count(*) as value from codex_fn_call_events_dashboard where $__timeFilter(event_time) and ($v$${team:text}$v$ = $v$All$v$ or team = $v$${team:text}$v$) and ($v$${user_id:text}$v$ = $v$All$v$ or user_id = $v$${user_id:text}$v$) and ($v$${conversation_id:text}$v$ = $v$All$v$ or conversation_id = $v$${conversation_id:text}$v$) and ($v$${repository:text}$v$ = $v$All$v$ or repository = $v$${repository:text}$v$) and ($v$${model:text}$v$ = $v$All$v$ or model = $v$${model:text}$v$) and is_done = true;

select now() as time, coalesce(round(100.0 * count(distinct te.tool_call_id)::numeric / nullif(count(distinct fc.item_id), 0), 2), 0) as value from codex_fn_call_events_dashboard fc left join codex_tool_events_dashboard te   on fc.item_id = te.tool_call_id   and coalesce(fc.session_id, '') = coalesce(te.session_id, '')   and te.event_name = 'codex.tool_decision' where $__timeFilter(fc.event_time) and ($v$${team:text}$v$ = $v$All$v$ or fc.team = $v$${team:text}$v$) and ($v$${user_id:text}$v$ = $v$All$v$ or fc.user_id = $v$${user_id:text}$v$) and ($v$${conversation_id:text}$v$ = $v$All$v$ or fc.conversation_id = $v$${conversation_id:text}$v$) and ($v$${repository:text}$v$ = $v$All$v$ or fc.repository = $v$${repository:text}$v$) and ($v$${model:text}$v$ = $v$All$v$ or fc.model = $v$${model:text}$v$) and fc.is_done = true;

select now() as time, coalesce(round((percentile_cont(0.95) within group (order by arguments_size))::numeric, 0), 0) as value from codex_fn_call_events_dashboard where $__timeFilter(event_time) and ($v$${team:text}$v$ = $v$All$v$ or team = $v$${team:text}$v$) and ($v$${user_id:text}$v$ = $v$All$v$ or user_id = $v$${user_id:text}$v$) and ($v$${conversation_id:text}$v$ = $v$All$v$ or conversation_id = $v$${conversation_id:text}$v$) and ($v$${repository:text}$v$ = $v$All$v$ or repository = $v$${repository:text}$v$) and ($v$${model:text}$v$ = $v$All$v$ or model = $v$${model:text}$v$) and is_done = true and arguments_size is not null;

select  coalesce(f.tool_name, '(unknown)') as tool_name,  count(distinct f.item_id) as fn_call_done_count,  count(distinct case when f.tool_decision is not null then f.item_id end) as decision_count,  count(distinct case when f.tool_success is not null then f.item_id end) as result_count,  count(distinct case when f.tool_success = true then f.item_id end) as success_count,  round(100.0 * count(distinct case when f.tool_decision is not null then f.item_id end)    / nullif(count(distinct f.item_id), 0), 2) as decision_rate_pct,  round(avg(f.arguments_size), 0) as avg_arguments_bytes,  round((percentile_cont(0.95) within group (order by f.arguments_size))::numeric, 0) as p95_arguments_bytes,  round(avg(f.prep_to_decision_ms), 2) as avg_prep_to_decision_ms from codex_tool_invocation_funnel f where $__timeFilter(f.fn_call_done_at) and ($v$${team:text}$v$ = $v$All$v$ or f.team = $v$${team:text}$v$) and ($v$${user_id:text}$v$ = $v$All$v$ or f.user_id = $v$${user_id:text}$v$) and ($v$${conversation_id:text}$v$ = $v$All$v$ or f.conversation_id = $v$${conversation_id:text}$v$) and ($v$${repository:text}$v$ = $v$All$v$ or f.repository = $v$${repository:text}$v$) and ($v$${model:text}$v$ = $v$All$v$ or f.model = $v$${model:text}$v$) group by f.tool_name order by fn_call_done_count desc, tool_name;

select event_time, user_id, session_id, item_id, model, arguments_size from codex_fn_call_events_dashboard where $__timeFilter(event_time) and ($v$${team:text}$v$ = $v$All$v$ or team = $v$${team:text}$v$) and ($v$${user_id:text}$v$ = $v$All$v$ or user_id = $v$${user_id:text}$v$) and ($v$${conversation_id:text}$v$ = $v$All$v$ or conversation_id = $v$${conversation_id:text}$v$) and ($v$${repository:text}$v$ = $v$All$v$ or repository = $v$${repository:text}$v$) and ($v$${model:text}$v$ = $v$All$v$ or model = $v$${model:text}$v$) and is_done = true order by event_time desc limit 50;

select $__timeGroupAlias(event_time, '5m'), round(avg(arguments_size), 0) as avg_arguments_bytes, round((percentile_cont(0.95) within group (order by arguments_size))::numeric, 0) as p95_arguments_bytes from codex_fn_call_events_dashboard where $__timeFilter(event_time) and ($v$${team:text}$v$ = $v$All$v$ or team = $v$${team:text}$v$) and ($v$${user_id:text}$v$ = $v$All$v$ or user_id = $v$${user_id:text}$v$) and ($v$${conversation_id:text}$v$ = $v$All$v$ or conversation_id = $v$${conversation_id:text}$v$) and ($v$${repository:text}$v$ = $v$All$v$ or repository = $v$${repository:text}$v$) and ($v$${model:text}$v$ = $v$All$v$ or model = $v$${model:text}$v$) and is_done = true and arguments_size is not null group by 1 order by 1;
